observation.visible_scene: A wide sky shot at sunset/sunrise: a blue gradient sky filled with scattered cumulus clouds whose lower edges glow orange from the low sun, a bright glow band along the horizon, and fixed foreground silhouettes — leafy trees on the right and a low rooftop with a small chimney/water tank at the bottom center. The camera and the ground objects do not move throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: The clouds drift slowly and continuously relative to the fixed horizon silhouettes, confirming real cloud motion rather than camera movement.

Additional cloud mass progressively enters the frame from the top edge: the upper border is nearly clear early on and becomes increasingly occupied by orange-lit cloud by the later frames, so total visible cloud cover in the upper half grows.
The large dark cloud on the left and the central cloud cluster retain roughly their positions and shapes, changing only slightly in extent as they drift.
The sunset glow along the horizon and the orange rim-lighting on the cloud undersides remain essentially constant in brightness and hue across the segment.
Foreground trees and rooftop stay in identical pixel positions in every frame (static camera).
outside_clip_unknowns: The wind speed/direction driving the cloud drift.
Whether the clouds entering from the top continue to advance or clear after the crop ends.
Any change in overall sky brightness before or after this excerpt.
uncertain_details: The precise vector of cloud translation (left/right vs. downward drift into the top edge) is hard to resolve because frame-to-frame shifts are very small.
Minor apparent size changes in individual clouds may be slow drift/deformation rather than new clouds forming.
